name: Cross Channel Notify
description: Push a short notification to a configured channel (e.g. WeChat) when a message arrives on any other channel.

notifyChannel.description: Channel to deliver notifications to. Default: openclaw-weixin

notifyTo.description: Recipient id on the notify channel (e.g. WeChat id). Required.

notifyAccountId.description: Account id on the notify channel (optional).

skipChannels.description: Channels whose inbound messages should be ignored. Default: [notifyChannel].

maxContentLength.description: Max chars of inbound content included in the notification. Default: 120.

cooldownMs.description: Min ms between notifications for the same channel+sender. Default: 30000.
